dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I'd like to take a quick walk around here. Would you mind?

choices.text: Not at all. It's not like I can keep you in my sights all the time anyway.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Our combat abilities aside, I will definitely stay put if that's what you prefer.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: However, you've also gotten to know me a bit by now. It's true that I'm not accustomed to staying in an unfamiliar place for long.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: But this is your home. We don't have to worry about danger here, right?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I'm curious, that's all. I just want to take a walk around this vast, miraculous place as if I were a tourist.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I can show you some other teapot realms, too, if you'd like.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: So, as long as you wish it, you can visit each of the seven nations without ever having to step outside?

choices.text: Want to give it a try?

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Haha, well, opportunities like that don't just come by every day.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: If you want something, you should try your best to fight for it, won't you agree?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Got it, I'll go switch up the realms for you.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: And I would be ever so grateful.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Obviously, I am also aware that there is no such thing as a free lunch.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: So, if you are ever in need of my help, don't let anything hold you back. We will always welcome you at the Fortress of Meropide.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Of course, with that said, I hope you won't be coming down because of a new sentence.

choices.text: I can already see your excitement.
I figured you would've already explored the place.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: That would have been true if we were elsewhere... Making sure that my surroundings are safe is essential.
